FEAT-3-S120.title: Clinical Trials Search Input/Output Schema Definition
FEAT-3-S120.description: Define and validate Pydantic models for clinical trials search inputs (condition, location, radius) and outputs (trial metadata, recruiting status, locations, travel distance/duration) to enforce contract consistency across layers.

FEAT-3-S121.title: Clinical Trials Search API Integration via Facade
FEAT-3-S121.description: Integrate clinical trials search service into EvaluateCare facade and expose as a tool-accessible API, ensuring proper orchestration, input validation, and response formatting for chat consumption.

FEAT-3-S122.title: Clinical Trials Search Unit and Integration Tests
FEAT-3-S122.description: Create unit tests for ClinicalTrials.gov query logic, recruiting filter enforcement, location extraction, and distance computation, plus integration tests validating end-to-end facade execution.
FEAT-3-S122.evidence: GAP: No existing clinical trials test coverage found; tests must be implemented to align with existing backend test patterns in Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/tests/
